area: next routing for adopters without taskflow profile
finding: In 3KLife (no taskflow adopter profile, no host opener) next keeps recommending taskflow open, which only returns the template-only fallback. Agents lose time following a route that cannot produce a governed ticket, while the repo actually governs PROG cards through its own task-lock flow and PR CI.
expectedBehavior: When no taskflow profile/opener is configured, next should say so explicitly and route to the host-declared workflow (or a neutral manual-host route) instead of advertising taskflow open as the primary action.
evidenceOrRepro: 3KLife next --prompt for PROG-2-10056 recommended taskflow open; taskflow open returned template-only fallback.
followUp: Model the fallback as data (host workflow declaration) rather than adopter-specific control flow.
